_comment: Streetwear demo feed clips. scripts/seed-street-demo-media.mjs resolves each `query` to a portrait Pexels video (Pexels License: free use, no watermark, no attribution required), pins the chosen `pexelsId` / `pexelsUrl` / `creator` back into this file, and writes public/demo-media/<slug>.mp4 + assets/videos/<slug>.jpg. Re-runs reuse pinned ids. Review the contact sheet for logos before committing.
